scripts.build:firefox: wxt build -b firefox && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/lib/message-history.test.ts src/lib/message-age-label.test.ts src/lib/i18n/resolve-locale.test.ts src/lib/message-text-policy.test.ts src/lib/nick-colors.test.ts src/lib/brand-colors.test.ts src/lib/url-utils.test.ts src/lib/sql-literal-escape.test.ts src/lib/live-badge.test.ts
scripts.publish: npm run test:unit && npm run check:locales && npm run icons:generate && npm run build:all
scripts.publish:chrome: npm run test:unit && npm run check:locales && npm run icons:generate && npm run build:chrome
scripts.publish:firefox: npm run test:unit && npm run check:locales && npm run icons:generate && npm run build:firefox
scripts.postinstall: wxt prepare && node scripts/patch-spacetimedb.js && node scripts/patch-spacetimedb-codegen.js
scripts.codegen:stdb: spacetime generate --lang typescript --out-dir src/lib/spacetimedb --module-path ../server && node scripts/patch-spacetimedb-codegen.js
